article_content: 'Spain tied Brazil's record of 35 unbeaten matches after a 2-0 victory against South Africa in the Confederations Cup in Bloemfontein.  David Villa and Fernando Llorente scored second-half goals to secure Spain's place in the semifinals.  Villa's goal, coming shortly after a saved penalty and involving a possible handball, proved controversial.  South Africa also advanced after New Zealand and Iraq drew 0-0.  Spain will surpass Brazil's record if they win their next match.'

Villa se doel, wat kort na 'n geredde strafskop gekom het en moontlik 'n handsbal behels het, was omstrede. Suid-Afrika het ook deurgedring nadat Nieu-Seeland en Irak 0-0 gelykop gespeel het. Spanje sal Brasilië se rekord oortref as hulle hul volgende wedstryd wen.'

article_content: John Hemming, a senior Liberal Democrat MP, has publicly challenged Hugh Tomlinson QC, a prominent barrister and advocate for the Hacked Off group, over his past use of legal injunctions. Hemming's critique, lodged through a Commons motion, centers on Tomlinson's representation of high-profile figures like footballer Ryan Giggs and banker Fred Goodwin, obtaining injunctions related to their personal affairs. Hemming also points to the case of Yvonne Goder, alleging Tomlinson's involvement in her imprisonment over email correspondence with the Law Society. He argues that these actions undermine freedom of expression and the rule of law. A spokesperson for Tomlinson responded by highlighting factual inaccuracies in Hemming's motion and emphasizing that barristers are bound to represent clients within their expertise, regardless of personal viewpoints. The spokesperson clarified that Tomlinson's legal arguments reflect client instructions, not his own opinions, and that while Hemming is free to criticize Tomlinson's views or those of Hacked Off, attributing client arguments to Tomlinson is inaccurate. Hemming specifically criticized the super-injunction secured by Tomlinson that initially prevented reporting of Giggs' affair with model Imogen Thomas and a similar injunction obtained for Goodwin concerning an affair with a staff member. He also questioned Tomlinson's role in the legal proceedings against Goder, who was jailed after emailing complaints about a solicitors' firm to the Law Society, alleging fraud related to her mother's case handled by the Court of Protection.
translated_content: John Hemming, 'n senior Liberaal Demokratiese parlementslid, het Hugh Tomlinson QC, 'n prominente advokaat en voorstander vir die Hacked Off-groep, in die openbaar uitgedaag oor sy vorige gebruik van regsinjunksies. Hemming se kritiek, ingedien deur 'n mosie in die Laerhuis, fokus op Tomlinson se verteenwoordiging van hoëprofiel figure soos sokkerspeler Ryan Giggs en bankier Fred Goodwin, waar hy injunksies verkry het met betrekking tot hul persoonlike sake. Hemming wys ook op die geval van Yvonne Goder en beweer dat Tomlinson betrokke was by haar gevangenisstraf oor e-poskorrespondensie met die Regsvereniging. Hy voer aan dat hierdie optrede die vryheid van spraak en die oppergesag van die reg ondermyn. 'n Woordvoerder van Tomlinson het gereageer deur feitelike onakkuraathede in Hemming se mosie uit te lig en te beklemtoon dat advokate verplig is om kliënte binne hul kundigheidsgebied te verteenwoordig, ongeag persoonlike standpunte. Die woordvoerder het verduidelik dat Tomlinson se regsargumente kliëntinstruksies weerspieël, nie sy eie menings nie, en dat hoewel Hemming vry is om Tomlinson se sienings of dié van Hacked Off te kritiseer, dit onakkuraat is om kliëntargumente aan Tomlinson toe te skryf. Hemming het spesifiek die super-injunksie gekritiseer wat deur Tomlinson verkry is wat aanvanklik verslaggewing oor Giggs se verhouding met model Imogen Thomas verhoed het, asook 'n soortgelyke injunksie wat vir Goodwin verkry is rakende 'n verhouding met 'n personeelledemaat. Hy het ook Tomlinson se rol in die regsgedinge teen Goder bevraagteken, wat gevange geneem is nadat sy klagtes oor 'n prokureursfirma per e-pos aan die Regsvereniging gestuur het, waarin sy bedrog beweer het met betrekking tot haar moeder se saak wat deur die Beskermingshof hanteer is.

article_content: 'Two-thirds of Australians support Prime Minister Tony Abbott\'s intention to confront Vladimir Putin over the downing of MH17.  A week after pledging to \'shirtfront\' the Russian president, a Newspoll reveals 63% back Abbott\'s firm stance while 27% oppose it. Abbott intends to hold robust talks with Putin at the G20 summit in Brisbane regarding the deaths of 38 Australians aboard MH17. Labor\'s lead has increased according to the poll, though Bill Shorten\'s disapproval rating has also risen.  Abbott remains the preferred prime minister.  He confirmed Putin\'s attendance at the summit, stating Australia cannot bar members. While Shorten stated he wouldn\'t meet with Putin, Abbott believes engagement is necessary. \'Shirtfront\', a term from Australian Rules Football, describes an aggressive front-on bump.'

Abbott beoog om stewige gesprekke met Poetin te voer tydens die G20-beraad in Brisbane oor die dood van 38 Australiërs aan boord van MH17.  Die Arbeidersparty se voorsprong het volgens die peiling toegeneem, hoewel Bill Shorten se afkeuringsgradering ook gestyg het.  Abbott bly die verkose eerste minister.  Hy het Poetin se bywoning van die beraad bevestig en gesê dat Australië nie lede kan verban nie. Terwyl Shorten gesê het dat hy nie met Poetin sou vergader nie, glo Abbott dat betrokkenheid noodsaaklik is. \'Shirtfront\', \'n term uit Australiese voetbal, beskryf \'n aggressiewe stamp van voor af.'

article_content: 'At a West Texas VA hospital, a former clerk who was also an Army veteran tragically shot and killed a psychologist before ending his own life on Tuesday.  The FBI revealed on Wednesday that the shooter, 48-year-old Jerry Serrato, had publicly threatened the doctor in 2013. The incident, which occurred at the El Paso Veterans Affairs Health Care System at Fort Bliss, triggered a lockdown, forcing hundreds of staff and patients to seek shelter. Serrato, who had been medically discharged from the Army in 2009 after serving in Iraq two years earlier, used a .380-caliber handgun in the attack.  Dr. Timothy Fjordbak, the 63-year-old victim, had left his private practice after the September 11th attacks to dedicate his career to working with military veterans. Serrato's military history includes service in the Ohio Army National Guard from 1985 to 1993, followed by enlistment in the Army in 2006 and a five-month deployment to Iraq in 2007.  While a clear motive remains undetermined, the FBI disclosed a 2013 incident where Serrato verbally threatened Fjordbak in a supermarket. Although both men were employed at the VA facility in 2013, authorities do not believe they had a direct working relationship.  The shooting resulted in a 'code white' lockdown, with staff members like Sutton Smith hiding for around two hours.  This security incident follows a recent assessment that found the base non-compliant with Department of Defense security directives.'

Die FBI het Woensdag onthul dat die skieter, die 48-jarige Jerry Serrato, die dokter in 2013 in die openbaar gedreig het. Die voorval, wat by die El Paso Veterane Sake Gesondheidsorgstelsel by Fort Bliss plaasgevind het, het 'n inperking veroorsaak, wat honderde personeel en pasiënte gedwing het om skuiling te soek. Dr. Timothy Fjordbak, die 63-jarige slagoffer, het sy privaat praktyk ná die 11 September-aanvalle verlaat om sy loopbaan aan militêre veterane te wy. Serrato se militêre geskiedenis sluit diens in die Ohio Army National Guard van 1985 tot 1993 in, gevolg deur inskrywing in die weermag in 2006 en 'n vyf maande lange ontplooiing na Irak in 2007. Hoewel 'n duidelike motief nog onbekend is, het die FBI 'n voorval in 2013 bekend gemaak waar Serrato Fjordbak mondeling in 'n supermark gedreig het. article_content: 'Condoleezza Rice, the former National Security Advisor, has stated her astonishment upon discovering that classified information regarding a mission to disrupt Iran's nuclear weapons program had been leaked to the media. During Jeffrey Sterling's trial, she emphasized the operation's highly confidential nature.  Sterling, a former CIA officer, is accused of revealing details of the operation, which involved a Russian informant known as 'Merlin' and the delivery of intentionally flawed nuclear blueprints to Iran, to journalist James Risen.  The prosecution alleges Sterling's actions were motivated by resentment towards the CIA. However, the defense contends that the leak could have come from various sources, given that over ninety individuals were privy to the operation's details, and they highlight Sterling's prior lawsuit against the CIA for racial discrimination. The trial has faced delays due to legal disputes concerning Risen's potential testimony. Although subpoenaed, Risen was ultimately not compelled to testify after advocacy efforts from press freedom groups.'
translated_content: 'Condoleezza Rice, die voormalige Nasionale Veiligheidsadviseur, het haar verbasing uitgespreek nadat sy ontdek het dat geklassifiseerde inligting rakende 'n sending om Iran se kernwapenprogram te ontwrig, aan die media uitgelek is. Tydens Jeffrey Sterling se verhoor het sy die uiters vertroulike aard van die operasie beklemtoon. Sterling, 'n voormalige CIA-beampte, word daarvan beskuldig dat hy besonderhede van die operasie, wat 'n Russiese informant bekend as 'Merlin' en die lewering van doelbewus gebrekkige kernbloudrukke aan Iran behels het, aan joernalis James Risen geopenbaar het. Die vervolging beweer dat Sterling se optrede deur wrok teenoor die CIA gemotiveer is. Die verdediging voer egter aan dat die lek uit verskeie bronne kon kom, aangesien meer as negentig individue van die besonderhede van die operasie bewus was, en hulle beklemtoon Sterling se vorige regsgeding teen die CIA vir rassediskriminasie. Die verhoor het vertragings ondervind weens regsgeding oor Risen se potensiële getuienis. Alhoewel hy gedagvaar is, is Risen uiteindelik nie gedwing om te getuig na die pogings van persvryheidsgroepe nie.'

article_content: 'In a significant architectural development, the London-based firm Assemblage has secured a victory in the international competition for the design of Iraq's new parliament building.  Chosen from a pool of 130 international competitors, Assemblage's design, focusing on integrated urban planning, stood out to the Royal Institute of British Architects (RIBA) jury. The proposed billion-dollar structure, to be located near Baghdad's al-Muhanna airport, will replace Saddam Hussein's abandoned super-mosque project. While awarded the $250,000 prize in August, the Iraqi government is currently also in discussions with Zaha Hadid Architects, who secured third place in the competition, adding a layer of complexity to the project's future. Assemblage's vision moves beyond a single imposing structure, proposing instead a network of streets and courtyards housing various government departments, community facilities, and public amenities like medical centers and libraries.  This urban approach, inspired by traditional Baghdadi houses, aims to create a vibrant and functional heart of Iraqi governance. Co-directors Hannah Corlett and Peter Besley emphasize their hope for the project's realization, envisioning a building cherished and utilized by the Iraqi people.  Corlett, known for her work on the Stirling Prize-winning Peckham Library, highlights the design's incorporation of local resources and sustainable practices, aligning with Western standards. This project follows Assemblage's other regional ventures, including a sustainable settlement design and a regeneration scheme for the holy city of Kadhimiya.'
translated_content: 'In 'n beduidende argitektoniese ontwikkeling het die Londense firma Assemblage 'n oorwinning behaal in die internasionale kompetisie vir die ontwerp van Irak se nuwe parlementsgebou.  Gekoos uit 'n poel van 130 internasionale mededingers, het Assemblage se ontwerp, wat fokus op geïntegreerde stedelike beplanning, uitgestaan teenoor die jurie van die Royal Institute of British Architects (RIBA). Die voorgestelde gebou van 'n miljard dollar, wat naby Bagdad se al-Muhanna-lughawe geleë sal wees, sal Saddam Hussein se verlate supermoskee-projek vervang.  Alhoewel die prys van $250,000 in Augustus toegeken is, is die Irakse regering tans ook in gesprek met Zaha Hadid Architects, wat die derde plek in die kompetisie behaal het, wat 'n laag kompleksiteit tot die projek se toekoms byvoeg. Assemblage se visie gaan verder as 'n enkele imposante struktuur en stel eerder 'n netwerk van strate en binnehowe voor wat verskeie regeringsdepartemente, gemeenskapsfasiliteite en openbare geriewe soos mediese sentrums en biblioteke huisves. Hierdie stedelike benadering, geïnspireer deur tradisionele Bagdadse huise, poog om 'n lewendige en funksionele hart van Irakse regering te skep. Mede-direkteure Hannah Corlett en Peter Besley beklemtoon hul hoop vir die verwesenliking van die projek en sien 'n gebou voor wat gekoester en gebruik sal word deur die Irakse volk. Corlett, bekend vir haar werk aan die Stirling-prysbekroonde Peckham-biblioteek, beklemtoon die ontwerp se inkorporering van plaaslike hulpbronne en volhoubare praktyke, in lyn met Westerse standaarde. Hierdie projek volg op Assemblage se ander streeksprojekte, insluitend 'n volhoubare nedersettingsontwerp en 'n regenerasieskema vir die heilige stad Kadhimiya.'

article_content: 'A teacher in Poyen, Arkansas, is facing criticism for bringing her infant to class and breastfeeding during lessons. Students have expressed mixed reactions, with some finding the baby's presence and occasional crying disruptive, while others consider the infant a non-issue. One student, identified as Sally, told KARK, 'It's a distraction, especially with teenage boys in the class.' Other students, Tyler and Chase Rhodes, disagreed, stating the baby is generally quiet and not a bother. The school principal clarified that teachers are allowed to bring children to class only in emergencies, declining further comment due to the sensitive nature of the situation.'

Leerlinge het gemengde reaksies, sommige vind die baba se teenwoordigheid en gehuil steurend, terwyl ander die baba nie as 'n probleem beskou nie.  'n Leerling, Sally, het aan KARK gesê: 'Dis 'n afleiding, veral met tienerseuns in die klas.' Ander leerlinge, Tyler en Chase Rhodes, stem nie saam nie en sê die baba is gewoonlik stil en nie 'n plaag nie. Die skoolhoof het verduidelik dat onderwysers kinders net in noodgevalle klas toe mag bring en wou nie verder kommentaar lewer nie weens die sensitiewe aard van die situasie.'
